ConnectionStrings.//: Set via user secrets or environment variables. Never commit credentials (SOW 3 - Security). Locally: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:DataIntelligenceDb" "<connection string>" --project src\DataIntelligence.Api
ConnectionStrings.//DataIntelligenceDbReadOnly: The AI assistant executes generated SQL on this connection, which must authenticate as a login in the di_ai_readonly role - SELECT on analytics.* only, DENY on sec and ai. Defence in depth behind ISqlSafetyValidator: a statement that slips past the validator still cannot write or read the audit log.

Assistant.//: ApiKey is never committed. A DeepSeek platform key (sk-...). Set it with: dotnet user-secrets set "Assistant:ApiKey" "<key>" --project src\DataIntelligence.Api
Assistant.//Model: GET https://api.deepseek.com/models lists what a key can reach: deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-pro. Note the id has no vendor prefix - 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash' is the OpenRouter spelling and is rejected here.
